headline: Angola Publishes Proposed 2027 Budget Documentation
summary: Angola's Finance Ministry made its proposed 2027 budget documentation available online, detailing government spending assumptions.
why: National budgets provide critical visibility into government fiscal policy, sovereign debt expectations, and public spending priorities for emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Angola
impacts.why: Transparency in government budgetary assumptions allows investors to better assess sovereign fiscal risk.
